name: Calvin Lo
office: City of San Marino, Member of the City Council

items.text: Calvin Lo is the vice mayor and a member of the San Marino City Council. He works as a real estate agent and luxury property specialist. He served on the Traffic Advisory Commission from 2016 to 2018 and as a San Marino Schools Foundation trustee from 2012 to 2014.

sentences.text: Calvin Lo is the vice mayor and a member of the San Marino City Council.
He works as a real estate agent and luxury property specialist.
He served on the Traffic Advisory Commission from 2016 to 2018 and as a San Marino Schools Foundation trustee from 2012 to 2014.

items.text: Lo voted to place a measure on the November ballot to raise the Utility Users Tax from 5% to 6% to fund police, fire, and library services. He said implementation of the tax must be transparent and tightly managed. He says he has worked to strengthen public safety, promote fiscal responsibility, preserve neighborhood character, and complete financial planning.
